notes.title: Update v0.5.5 - Tutorial, Ghosts in Freeride and New Race Track
notes.notes:
[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
The tutorial is now available and it will show you the basics of riding bikes. 

A more extended tutorial for tricks and in air control will come in the future updates.

[h2]NEW Race Track[/h2]
There is a new track specifically designed for the tutorial. This track is a circuit and you have two new races to beat!

[h2]Ghosts in Freeride[/h2]
Never ride alone anymore! Freeride mode will show random racers' ghosts going down hill. You can also turn it off if you prefer riding solo.


[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you for playing Down Fast VR!
2023 will be exciting year so stay tuned not to miss any updates :) 

Have a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update v0.5.42
notes.notes:
1. Bug fix for bike going under map when starting a race from freeride mode

2. Loading screen added (To be improved in future builds)

3. Bug fixes for Urban map races bugged checkpoints. The checkpoints were in wrong order and this was causing restarts

4. Changed default settings
  - Default bike is now the Monster bike.
  - Steering assistance is off by default.

5. Bug fix for races starting before the ghosts have loaded

Happy holidays!

notes.title: Update v0.5.40a
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

Thank you for playing Down Fast VR while it is early in Early Access!

Here is a small update which should make your experience a bit better.

When you first launch the game after the new update you will be faced with a screen which has some options for comfort and bike control. There are even more options in the settings menu > Advanced settings.

This patch also brings some general fixes for the default bike like making it's suspension better and improving the traction.

Below is the full change log.

[h2]Change Notes
[/h2]
[h3]1. Adjusted brake strength. [/h3]
  Brakes are now stronger and more useful
  
[h3]2. Fine tuned the default bike [/h3]
[list]
[*]  suspension updated so that it is smoother
[*]  Updated tires friction models
[/list]

[h3]3. Control Settings[/h3]
 - [list]
[*]Steering assistance Toggle. Switching off assistances gives you full control of the steering
[*]Toggle Wheelies. Wheelies are now switched off by default. TO DO: Calibration for the weight transfer   
[/list]
 
[h3]4. Camera Settings[/h3]
 Disable Camera smoothing for better experience. Can be fine tuned but some settings can cause nausea and vomitting so be careful! 
 
Enjoy the ride and share your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/8Cf24BuneM]Down Fast VR Discord[/url] :)

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE: Updated UI and Settings. Camera fixes. More options. Better Control
notes.notes:
Hey thank you for playing the Early Demo of Down Fast VR. 
I understand that there are issues and am working on fixing them. Thank you very much for playing this early version of the game and helping in identifying the problems :) 

Please don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/t8BFsxcuuY]Join the Discord[/url] and let me know your feedback.

This update brings a reworked UI and more options in the settings. 

You will now be able to Mute all sounds or control the music volume.

Updated camera tracking to get rid of the "floating" feeling which should help with decreasing motion sickness.

Added an option to switch Depth Of Field. It is turned off by default.

Updated In Air control so that you won't go into crazy spins

Removed Calibration option and using a default one which should work well for the average human arm length ːsteamhappyː. A setting for it will come soon in one of the next updates.

Added an option to disable Haptic Feedback as requested in the forum. 
Don't hesitate to request changes in the Down Fast VR forum and contribute to the game. There will be free steam keys giveaways :) 

Added a written HOW TO RIDE explanation. The tutorial is coming soooooon... 

I am very happy to anounce that @antgrass has joined the team as 3D artist and level designer and he is the mastermind behind the map available in the Demo.

He is working on a new very exciting Map which will be included in the Early Access version which is coming later this year

Another nice update but still early draft is the option to swithc to RIDER mode which gives you more control on your bike and the ability to steer and lean independently :) 

Thank you all and have fun going downhill very fast! 

[url=https://freeimage.host/][img]https://iili.io/jd3ebS.png[/img][/url]

P.S. The first [b]5 of you[/b] who show me a video of [b]you beat[/b]ing  or achieving my best time of [b]0:52[/b] seconds [b]you have a free steam KEY[/b] for when the game goes into Early Access : )

notes.title: Small update of Down Fast VR demo
notes.notes:
As many of you requested I have removed the Depth of Field which will hopefully bring you a better experience and will get rid of all the blurriness.

Another small change is made to the sounds. 
Removed the annoying sounds and added more musical genres to the playlist :) Hope those of you who disliked the original soundtrack would enjoy the game more :) 

The plan for the next update is to rework the UI and add sound settings, and skip song buttons :) 

If you have any suggestions feel free to contact me on [url=https://discord.gg/t8BFsxcuuY]Down Fast VR Discord server[/url]
